lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to speak to the Israelites about a man with a bodily discharge, which is unclean.
Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and when he is cleansed he counts seven days.
On the eighth day the cleansed man gives two turtledoves or two young pigeons to Aaron, who sacrifices them.
A woman with a flow of blood is unclean for forty days, and anyone touching her is unclean until evening.
